items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve got probably an LP upstairs of Herbie playing “Watermelon Man.” That’s what I remember about him.

ctx.x: And historically well secured there. Since that time, who are the players . . . I’ll give you a few names just to start thinking about it. Seeing a McCoy Tyner or Herbie Hancock or Chick Corea come on the scene, and others, Harold Mabern, whoever . . .

All those people. All those people. I’ve got probably an LP upstairs of Herbie playing “Watermelon Man.” That’s what I remember about him. And certain points . . . certain records of his that I liked a lot. Tunes like “Maiden Voyage” and “Tell Me a Bedtime Story.” There’s a bunch of things.
